role: Kiosk Order Creation + Fiscal Allocation Specialist
scope_description: Steps 1-3 (kiosk wizard completion -> Frontend/OrderController::store -> fiscal_sequence_no allocation AT CREATION per NF525 -> OrderCreated event -> outbox) + Step 7 (NF525 chain gap-free verification across kiosk+POS orders).

invariants_verified.title: Outbox-first listener registration ordering
invariants_verified.expectation: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox runs BEFORE side-effect listeners (FCM, stock, availability) so the durable DomainEvent row is committed even if a downstream sync listener throws.
invariants_verified.evidence: app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php:145-151 registers PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox first, then DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder, DecrementStockOnOrderCreated, SendFcmOnOrderCreated. Comment block at :130-137 explicitly documents the F-002 round-3 ordering invariant.

invariants_verified.title: Idempotent outbox write under listener replay
invariants_verified.expectation: If the listener fires twice for the same order (queue retry between persistence and post-commit dispatch), only one DomainEvent row exists and only one DispatchDomainEventsJob is queued.
invariants_verified.evidence: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox.php:22 builds idempotency_key=sha1(ORDER_CREATED|aggregate_id); :24 firstOrCreate on that key; :57-59 short-circuits returns when wasRecentlyCreated=false (skips the afterCommit dispatch registration entirely on replay). DB UNIQUE on domain_events(idempotency_key) per migration 2026_05_09_180000.

invariants_verified.title: OrderCreated dispatch deferred until DB::transaction commits (no ghost orders on rollback)
invariants_verified.expectation: OrderCreated must use afterCommit semantics so KDS/OSS consumers never observe an order that did not actually persist.
invariants_verified.evidence: app/Events/OrderCreated.php uses DispatchableAfterCommit trait (per docstring). PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox itself registers DispatchDomainEventsJob inside DB::afterCommit() at :61, double-layered defense.

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk paid-at-creation dispatch gate (truth table)
invariants_verified.expectation: Cash kiosk (PENDING_COUNTER) auto-accepts + dispatches OrderCreated immediately. Card / TR kiosk DEFERS dispatch until paymentConfirm flips ps=PAID (no ghost orders pre-TPE).
invariants_verified.evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:205-247 documents the gate truth table; line 236 builds $shouldDispatchNewOrderSignals = !$isKioskOrderType || $isCounterDeferredKioskCash || !$isKioskPaymentMethod. Lines 599-606 fire SendOrderMail/Sms/Push + dispatchNewOrderSignals only when gate is true. The card/TR deferred path lands at FrontendOrderService.php:1212 inside finalizePaidKioskOrder, called from OrderController::paymentConfirm:267 only after the prior DB::transaction commits payment_status=PAID + transaction_id.

invariants_verified.title: NF525 fiscal_sequence_no allocated INSIDE the same DB::transaction as ACCEPT status promotion
invariants_verified.expectation: For deferred kiosk card/TR path, allocation + promotion must be atomic. Allocation failure must rollback promotion (stays PENDING). Re-attempt persists fiscal_alloc_error_at marker so foodking:fiscal:retry-alloc cron picks it up — never throws upward.
invariants_verified.evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:1086-1195 wraps allocation + status update in DB::transaction. Allocation at :1130-1190; catch at :1154-1189 writes $locked->fiscal_alloc_error_at = now() INSIDE the same closure then returns (no throw). On success, :1142-1144 clears the error flag. config('fiscal.kiosk_auto_allocate_sequence', true) gates the auto-alloc with env override for emergency rollback.

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk-cash path follows POS cash AT-CLOSE timing — not at kiosk creation
invariants_verified.expectation: Per NF525 §8 prompt framing: kiosk paid orders allocate AT CREATION, but kiosk-cash (PENDING_COUNTER / COUNTER_DEFERRED) is a hybrid — the kiosk only creates the order at status=ACCEPT with payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER, no sequence allocated. The cashier physically collects cash at the counter and triggers PaymentService::collect which calls FiscalSequenceService::next at that moment. This mirrors the POS cash at-close pattern, not the kiosk paid-at-creation pattern.
invariants_verified.evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:265-266 sets payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER + pos_payment_method=COUNTER_DEFERRED for kiosk cash; no FiscalSequenceService::next call in this code path. Allocation happens later at PaymentService.php:206-207 ($locked->fiscal_sequence_no = app(FiscalSequenceService::class)->next) — same per-branch counter pool as direct kiosk TPE and direct POS cash. KitchenReleaseRule.php:70-72 already documents the POS=cash special-case for kitchen release; kiosk-cash benefits from the same auto-accept-without-PAID path.

invariants_verified.title: NF525 chain integrity — re-walked HMAC verification
invariants_verified.expectation: audit_logs + z_reports HMAC chains valid; no fork, no tamper, no orphan row.
invariants_verified.evidence: Ran `php artisan fiscal:verify-chain --all` at HEAD 50bdd5150. Output: `+ branch=1 CHAIN OK / SWEEP COMPLETE — CHAIN OK on every active branch (1 total)`. Exit code 0.

invariants_verified.title: No duplicate (branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no) tuples
invariants_verified.expectation: DB UNIQUE constraint orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique prevents two orders from sharing a sequence number on the same branch.
invariants_verified.evidence: SHOW INDEX FROM orders confirms orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique on (branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no), Non_unique=0. DB tinker query: `SELECT branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no, count(*) GROUP BY HAVING c>1` returned zero rows.

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk + POS share a single per-branch sequence pool, interleaved by allocation order
invariants_verified.expectation: Both kiosk (FrontendOrderService::finalizePaidKioskOrder:1134) and POS (OrderService.php:938 / PaymentService.php:207) call the SAME FiscalSequenceService::next(branchId). NF525 requires one contiguous receipt sequence per fiscal entity.
invariants_verified.evidence: branch=1 db dump of first 20 fiscal_sequence_no shows interleaving: seq 8=kiosk, 9-10=pos, 11=kiosk, 12-17=pos, 18=kiosk, 19-21=pos. Single MAX(fiscal_sequence_no)+1 strategy in FiscalSequenceService.php:88-93.

invariants_verified.title: Cross-branch isolation on OrderCreated outbox row
invariants_verified.expectation: DomainEvent.branch_id = order.branch_id; broadcast channel = private-branch.{order.branch_id}; channel auth in routes/channels.php prevents cross-branch leak.
invariants_verified.evidence: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox.php:30 sets branch_id from $order->branch_id. :43 sets channel = ['private-branch.' . $order->branch_id]. routes/channels.php:41-62 'branch.{branchId}' authorizes (a) kiosk-token only for its KioskMachine.branch_id (token-name check, immune to Sanctum '*' wildcard per R3 T-3.2.2 Sec F-SEC-W6-01 heal), (b) Admin/Tenant Admin role-based cross-branch, (c) regular staff only own branch.

invariants_verified.title: DispatchDomainEventsJob atomic claim — no double broadcast under retry
invariants_verified.expectation: Concurrent or retried jobs claim the row under lockForUpdate + dispatched_at NULL guard; loser observes dispatched_at != null and silently returns. Broadcast happens OUTSIDE the claim transaction (commit_before_dispatch invariant).
invariants_verified.evidence: app/Jobs/DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:65-94 phase 1 atomic claim under DB::transaction with lockForUpdate; :88-94 skip path. Phase 2 (validation + broadcast) at :96-117 runs OUTSIDE the transaction. tries=6 backoff [1,5,15,60,300] documented at :40-42.

findings.title: source enum mislabel — kiosk client sends source=5 (WEB) but DashboardService treats source=10 (APP) as the kiosk count

evidence.client: public/js/app.js:133611 sets `var SOURCE_KIOSK = 5;` with comment `// Source identique à sourceEnum.WEB (pas de valeur KIOSK côté frontend)`. Sent on every kiosk POST /frontend/order via buildKioskQuotePayload:133749.
evidence.backend_validation: app/Http/Requests/OrderRequest.php:179 accepts any numeric source without enum-narrowing.
evidence.downstream_consumer: app/Services/DashboardService.php:442 counts `source = Source::APP` as kiosk (`$app = $orders->where('source', \App\Enums\Source::APP)->count(); // Utilisé pour le kiosk`).
evidence.runtime_db_state: DB has 152 kiosk orders (source_surface='kiosk') all with source=5; 0 with source=10. POS orders correctly tagged source=15. Result: dashboard 'kiosk' bucket is always 0; 152 kiosk orders silently miscounted into the 'web' bucket.

findings.impact: Analytics-only — sync correctness is unaffected because KdsSyncService/OSS query by `order_type` + `source_surface` (correct), not by `source`. But owner dashboards underreport kiosk usage by ~100% (all kiosk reads as web).
findings.blast_radius: DashboardService.php:441-443; any owner UI that consumes this metric. KDS/OSS sync paths are UNAFFECTED.
remediation_options: Server-side: force `source = Source::APP` when KioskMachine token detected (FrontendOrderService.php near line 196 where $isKioskMachineOrder is established).
Client-side: change SOURCE_KIOSK constant in app.js from 5 to 10 (Source::APP) — requires Mix rebuild + manifest update.
Both: server-side authoritative override is the discipline-correct fix (clients can be forged/legacy/replayed).
findings.confidence: HIGH (runtime db query + grep both confirm)

findings.title: fiscal_sequence_no gap rate 48% (172 gaps / 355 range) — rolled-back transactions burn sequence numbers

evidence.db_state: branch=1: min=1 max=355 alive_count=183 missing=172. Missing seqs include 6,88-98,105-128,261,264-282,317-323,335-337.
evidence.allocation_strategy: FiscalSequenceService.php:88-93 — MAX(fiscal_sequence_no)+1 inside DB::transaction with lockForUpdate. Strategy guarantees monotonic + no-duplicate but a transaction that allocates then rolls back leaves the seq abandoned (next caller skips ahead).
evidence.nf525_compliance_note: NF525 / Loi Finance anti-fraude requires HMAC chain integrity over audit_logs + z_reports (verified PASS in INV-A1-06). Strict gap-freeness of `fiscal_sequence_no` integer is NOT a hard NF525 requirement — the legal chain is the HMAC chain, not the per-receipt counter. However, 48% gap rate is an operational health signal.

findings.impact: Operational: hard to diagnose silent rollback failures from a sequence-skip alone. NF525 audit-of-record (HMAC chain) remains intact. Some auditors view large gaps as a credibility concern even if chain is valid.
remediation_options: Add fiscal_sequence_allocated_at_skipped event log when MAX(seq) jumps by >1 between two committed orders — surfaces rollback hotspots.
Track in BRAIN as health metric (target gap_rate < 10% under normal POS load); spike alert via existing observability dashboards.

findings.title: Comment-vs-prompt nomenclature drift — Source enum has no KIOSK constant

evidence.prompt_statement: Wave-F prompt step 5 says 'OSS receives kiosk order with source=KIOSK (matches public wall allowlist)'.
evidence.code_reality_1: app/Enums/Source.php declares only WEB=5, APP=10, POS=15. No KIOSK constant.
evidence.code_reality_2: OSS allowlist in OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:59-63, 196-200 filters by `order_type` (KIOSK=25 / TAKEAWAY=10), NOT by `source`.
evidence.code_reality_3: DashboardService.php:442 comment 'Utilisé pour le kiosk' on Source::APP — but client actually sends Source::WEB (see WF3-A1-P1-01).
evidence.fields_in_play: Three distinct columns confused in informal speech: (a) `source` (int enum WEB/APP/POS), (b) `source_surface` (varchar kiosk/pos/web/mobile, the truthy operational tag), (c) `order_type` (DELIVERY/TAKEAWAY/POS/DINING_TABLE/KIOSK, the channel-by-fulfillment-mode tag).

findings.impact: Audit ambiguity. New engineers reading the OSS query mistake source-filter for the discriminator when it's actually order_type. Owner / auditor briefings risk repeating the prompt's mislabel.
remediation_options: Add ADR / docs/ARCHITECTURE.md note on the three-fields-three-meanings split (source vs source_surface vs order_type).
Inline comment block above OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:59 explaining the choice (order_type-driven allowlist, source-field intentionally ignored for OSS routing).

verdict.summary: Kiosk -> OrderCreated -> outbox -> broadcast path is structurally sound. NF525 chain integrity confirmed at runtime (PASS_RUNTIME on fiscal:verify-chain --all). Fiscal allocation at-creation (kiosk paid path) is atomically tied to status promotion via DB::transaction with error-flag fallback. The dispatch gate truth table correctly defers OrderCreated on card/TR until TPE confirms (no ghost KDS orders).
verdict.production_readiness: GO with P1 source-enum mislabel fix scheduled (analytics-only, not sync-blocking)
